profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer with three years of professional experience. I am proficient at applying software architecture, design, and programming to complex business scenarios. These skills, along with my experience with Agile development, requirements analysis, and client relations make me a valuable addition to any team.

I graduated from Rose-Hulman Institute of Technology with a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and Software Engineering in 2022. Since then, I have been working for Encora (formerly DMI) as a contractor for Liberty Mutual Insurance Company. This work has given me numerous opportunities to further develop my knowledge and give me the experience to create significant and lasting business value.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contractor at Liberty Mutual Insurance Company
•	Key contributor to the architecture design and incremental delivery plan to replace legacy system by using the Strangler Fig pattern to ensure system availability.
•	Performed setup of 2 key repositories, including test coverage, code linting, file structure, and CI/CD pipelines.
•	Collaborated with large team of UX designer, product owners, and developers to create and refine Jira tickets in an agile environment.
•	Contributed to first successful production release of greenfield application, with positive user feedback and ongoing incremental delivery.
•	On-boarded a large group of new developers by consolidating documentation and engaging in job shadowing sessions.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer (formerly DMI, acquired March 2025)
positions.description:
Contractor at Liberty Mutual Insurance Company
•	Implemented financial calculations to enable the automated processing of multiple types of transactions, heavily collaborating with business stakeholders and data analyst to validate behavior.
•	Collaborated with large team of full-time and contract software engineers for full stack development in React and Ruby on Rails.
•	Developed new features to support internationalization of legacy application, including a new user interface, data model, and backend calculations.
•	Became go-to expert by implementing Change transaction type using the new data model without affecting existing workflows.
•	Created and demonstrated proof-of-concept design of AI text recognition tool to automate the process of entering documents into web forms.

positions.title: Supervisor
positions.description:
•	Promoted to supervisor position as a freshman.
•	Provided math and science tutoring to middle and high school students while simultaneously 
        supervising the contact center.
•	Worked in environment dependent on communication and teamwork skills.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed, developed and tested an image drag-and-drop feature to improve app usability for gastroenterologists reviewing medical images of patients.
•	Collaborated with management, UX designers, and quality assurance to deliver a completed project.
•	Presented several iterations of progress and results to the division, company, and end users.
•	Finished code review and pushed the project to quality testing to be shipped to live customer environments.

volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Developed software for automatic collection of data by Lowell Observatory Solar Telescope.
•	Collaborated with astronomers to understand technical details of telescopes.
